title.zh: 併購後整合與跨國文化融合 (PMI 100 天戰略藍圖)

slide_title.zh: 併購戰略初衷與整合風險 (SCQA & PMI Mandate)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：我們已成功完成對 [目標公司] 的收購 (Closing)，正式取得其在 [特定技術/海外市場] 的市佔率
衝突 (Complication)：歷史數據顯示，70% 的併購案因「文化衝突」與「整合延宕」而未能實現預期價值 (Value Leakage)
戰略訴求 (The Ask)：提議正式啟動「PMI 專案辦公室 (IMO)」，懇請核准 100 天整合藍圖與關鍵人才留任預算
en: Situation: We have successfully closed the acquisition of [Target Company], securing critical market share in [Technology/Region].
Complication: Historically, 70% of M&A deals destroy value due to cultural clashes and delayed integration (Value Leakage).
The Ask: Activating the Integration Management Office (IMO). Requesting Board approval for the 100-Day Blueprint and key talent retention budget.

speaker_notes.zh: 各位董事，簽約 (Signing) 只是典禮，交割 (Closing) 後的整合 (PMI) 才是戰爭的開始。我們花了大筆資金買下這家公司，如果不把文化與營運真正融合，這筆投資就會變成財報上的巨大商譽減損 (Goodwill Impairment)。今天的提案，是為了確保我們能把紙上談兵的『綜效』，變成真實落袋的利潤。
speaker_notes.en: Members of the Board, Signing is merely a ceremony; the real war begins post-Closing with Integration (PMI). We deployed significant capital for this acquisition. If we fail to synthesize operations and culture, this investment devolves into a massive goodwill impairment. Today's blueprint ensures we convert theoretical 'synergies' into realized bottom-line profit.

slide_title.zh: 綜效兌現與價值捕獲 (Synergy Realization & Tracking)

zh: 硬綜效 (Cost Synergies)：鎖定 [X] 萬美元的成本縮減，主要透過 IT 系統整併、供應鏈集中採購與後勤部門 (Back-office) 重疊精簡
軟綜效 (Revenue Synergies)：啟動交叉銷售 (Cross-selling) 計畫，預計在第一年內將新產品導入我方現有客戶群，帶來 [X]% 營收增長
紀律追蹤 (Tracking Discipline)：IMO 將建立「綜效儀表板」，每月向董事會匯報整合進度，任何落後指標將立即觸發紅燈警示
en: Hard Synergies (Cost): Targeting [$X] in cost reductions via IT consolidation, centralized procurement, and back-office rationalization.
Soft Synergies (Revenue): Launching cross-selling initiatives to introduce new IP to our existing client base, projecting a [X]% top-line boost in Year 1.
Tracking Discipline: The IMO will deploy a 'Synergy Dashboard,' reporting monthly to the Board. Any lagging metrics will trigger immediate red-light interventions.

speaker_notes.zh: 併購不是為了把兩家公司湊在一起，而是為了達到 1+1>3。我們將『綜效』嚴格區分為降本（硬綜效）與增收（軟綜效）。最重要的是，我們不會讓這些數字只停留在 Excel 裡，PMI 辦公室將以最高紀律，每個月追蹤這些綜效的兌現進度。
speaker_notes.en: We didn't execute this M&A to simply co-locate two companies; the goal is 1+1>3. We have ruthlessly categorized synergies into cost-reduction (Hard) and revenue-generation (Soft). Crucially, these numbers won't remain hypothetical Excel projections; the IMO will track value realization with military discipline every single month.

slide_title.zh: 人才防禦與文化融合 (Talent Retention & Glocalization)

zh: 關鍵人才鎖定 (Key Talent Retention)：已辨識 [X] 位不可取代的核心工程師與業務大將，並核發綁定績效的留任獎金 (Retention Bonus)
文化盡職調查 (Cultural Due Diligence)：盤點雙方在「決策速度」與「風險偏好」上的文化差異，避免強勢併吞引發的骨牌式離職
全球在地化 (Glocalization)：在核心治理上實施總部標準 (Global Standard)，但在業務前線保留當地市場的靈活度 (Local Agility)
en: Key Talent Retention: Identified [X] mission-critical engineers and sales rainmakers, locking them in with performance-vested Retention Bonuses.
Cultural Due Diligence: Audited gaps in 'decision-making speed' and 'risk appetite' to prevent a domino-effect exodus triggered by heavy-handed assimilation.
Glocalization: Enforcing Global Standards for core governance/compliance while preserving Local Agility for frontline commercial operations.

speaker_notes.zh: 我們買的是這家公司的資產，但真正創造價值的是『人』。如果核心團隊在交割後三個月內跑光，這場併購就失敗了一半。HR 團隊已經啟動了精準的留任計畫。在文化上，我們絕對不搞『帝國主義式』的粗暴併吞，而是採取『Glocalization（全球在地化）』——後台合規統一，前台業務放權。
speaker_notes.en: We purchased their assets, but value is generated by their 'People.' If the core team walks out within 90 days of closing, the deal is a failure. HR has activated surgical retention plans. Culturally, we reject heavy-handed, 'imperial' assimilation. We adopt 'Glocalization'—centralized back-office compliance coupled with decentralized frontline agility.

slide_title.zh: Day 1 營運連續性準備 (Day 1 Operational Readiness)

zh: 對外溝通 (External Comms)：Day 1 上午同步向全球客戶、供應商與投資人發布整合聲明，保證業務與服務級別 (SLA) 絕不中斷
系統橋接 (IT & Data)：首日完成電子郵件網域統一與核心 ERP/CRM 系統的單點登入 (SSO)，確保跨團隊溝通無縫接軌
合規過渡 (Legal & HR)：完成勞動合約的合法轉移，並統一員工薪資福利與核心內控政策 (Code of Conduct)
en: External Comms: Simultaneous Day 1 communications to global clients, vendors, and investors, guaranteeing zero disruption to SLAs.
IT & Data Bridging: Unified email domains and active SSO for core ERP/CRM systems on Day 1 to ensure seamless cross-entity collaboration.
Legal & HR Transition: Executed lawful transfer of employment contracts, harmonizing payroll, benefits, and the unified Code of Conduct.

speaker_notes.zh: 所謂的『Day 1』，就是併購交割後的第一個營業日。我們的最高指導原則是『營運連續性』——對客戶來說，服務不能中斷；對員工來說，電腦要能登入、薪水要照常發放。法務、HR 與 IT 已經完成壓力測試，確保第一天我們就是一家公司，而不是兩組貌合神離的人馬。
speaker_notes.en: 'Day 1' is the inaugural business day post-closing. Our ultimate directive is 'Operational Continuity.' Clients must experience zero friction; employees must be able to log in and get paid. Legal, HR, and IT have stress-tested all systems to ensure we operate as a single unified enterprise from minute one, not two disjointed factions.

slide_title.zh: 百日整合藍圖與決策訴求 (The 100-Day Roadmap & The Ask)

zh: 首 30 天 (穩定與溝通)：確保 Day 1 順利上線，完成核心人才留任，並確立新的組織架構與匯報線 (Reporting Lines)
30-100 天 (綜效與優化)：啟動跨部門專案，開始削減重疊成本，並展開交叉銷售 (Cross-selling) 行動
決策訴求 (Call to Action)：懇請董事會授權成立 PMI 專案辦公室 (IMO)，並核准 [X 萬] 的專項整合與人才留任預算
en: First 30 Days (Stabilize & Communicate): Ensure a flawless Day 1, secure key talent, and lock in the new organizational structure and reporting lines.
Days 30-100 (Synergize & Optimize): Launch cross-functional squads to eliminate redundant costs and execute initial cross-selling campaigns.
Call to Action: Requesting Board mandate to formally empower the IMO and approve the [$X] integration and retention budget.

speaker_notes.zh: 百日計畫決定了併購案的生死。前 30 天我們求穩，把人才跟組織架構安頓好；30 到 100 天我們求戰，開始收割商業綜效。為了打贏這場硬仗，我們需要董事會充分授權 PMI 專案辦公室，並核准這筆救命的整合預算。我們準備好去把價值拿回來了。
speaker_notes.en: The first 100 days dictate the ultimate success or failure of the M&A. Days 1-30 are about stabilization—securing talent and structure. Days 30-100 are about offense—harvesting commercial synergies. To win this battle, we need the Board to fully empower the IMO and approve this critical integration budget. We are ready to capture the value.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『併購後整合與文化融合 (PMI 100 天藍圖)』簡報。受眾為董事會、CEO 或併購專案辦公室 (IMO)。內容必須展現跨域整合 (HR/法務/營運) 的最高戰略視野：1. 運用 SCQA 強調併購後『價值流失 (Value Leakage)』的風險，2. 將綜效嚴格劃分為降本 (Hard Synergies) 與增收 (Soft Synergies) 並提出追蹤紀律，3. 提出防止核心人才流失的留任計畫 (Retention) 與 Glocalization (全球在地化) 文化融合策略，4. 確保 Day 1 的營運連續性 (IT/HR/客戶溝通)，5. 結尾給出明確的 100 天整合里程碑，並要求董事會授權 IMO 與留任預算。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需充滿掌控力、執行力與捍衛投資 ROI 的決心。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Post-Merger Integration & Cultural Synergy (PMI)' presentation in English. Audience: Board of Directors, CEO, or Integration Management Office (IMO). Demonstrate elite cross-functional (HR/Legal/Ops) orchestration: 1. Use SCQA to highlight the existential risk of 'Value Leakage' post-closing. 2. Categorize synergies into Cost (Hard) and Revenue (Soft) with strict tracking disciplines. 3. Detail aggressive Talent Retention strategies and a 'Glocalization' approach to cultural assimilation. 4. Guarantee Day 1 Operational Continuity across IT, HR, and external communications. 5. Conclude with a definitive 100-Day Integration Roadmap, demanding Board authorization for the IMO and retention budget. Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must project absolute control, execution rigor, and a fierce commitment to protecting the M&A ROI.
